Nynne Nyboe Andersen is a senior clinician and researcher in Region Sjælland (Zealand Region) in Denmark. She holds the position of department physician (afdelingslæge), has a doctorate (ph.d.), and serves as a clinical lecturer (klinisk lektor) [^src1]. 

She is a member of [[danibd|DANIBD]]'s steering committee (styrgruppe), where she represents the clinical and research interests of her region. DANIBD is Denmark's national registry for inflammatory bowel diseases, encompassing patients treated at public Danish hospitals for Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, short bowel syndrome, and primary sclerosing cholangitis [^src1]. The steering committee includes representatives from all five Danish regions, alongside patient representatives and data administrators [^src1].

No further biographical details, claims, or timeline events are available in the corpus.
